name: Stuffed Pita Pockets
description: A refreshing appetizer featuring mini pita pockets filled with a creamy ranch and feta cheese mixture, topped with cucumbers and tomatoes.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the softened cream cheese, mayonnaise, and powdered ranch dressing mix until well combined.
Crumble feta cheese into the cream cheese mixture and stir to combine.
Cut the mini pita pockets in half and fill with the cheese mixture.
Top with diced cucumbers and tomatoes.
Serve and enjoy.

keywords: pita pockets, ranch dip, feta cheese, appetizer

_similar.name: Sloppy Joe Squares
_similar.description: A layered casserole featuring a sloppy joe beef mixture between two layers of crescent roll dough, topped with mozzarella cheese and baked until golden brown.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the beef, onions, and spices in a skillet over medium heat until the meat is no longer red.
Blend in flour to thicken the mixture.
Add 1¼ cups water, ketchup, and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.
Preheat oven to 350°F and line a 9×13 inch pan with 1 package of crescent rolls.
Spread the beef mixture evenly over the layer of rolls.
Top the beef mixture with mozzarella cheese.
Cover with the second package of crescent dinner rolls, ensuring the dough touches the edges of the pan.
Bake at 350°F until the crescent rolls are browned.
Serve with a salad.

_similar.keywords: sloppy joe, casserole, crescent rolls, beef

_similar.name: Veggie Pizza
_similar.description: A simple and customizable veggie pizza using crescent rolls as the crust, topped with a cream cheese mixture and various vegetables.
recipeIngredient: Veggies (broccoli, cauliflower, carrots, celery, red or green peppers, green onions)

recipeInstructions.text: Roll out crescent rolls on a cookie sheet and a small cake pan. Bake until golden brown. Cool.
Mix sour cream, mayonnaise, cream cheese, and ranch dressing to make the cream mixture.
Spread cream mixture on cooled rolls.
Top with finely chopped vegetables of your choice.
Cover with grated cheddar cheese.
Chill and cut into small pieces. Serve as hors d'oeuvres.

_similar.name: Veggie Pizza
_similar.description: A simple veggie pizza made with a crescent roll crust, cream cheese, ranch dressing, and various chopped vegetables.
recipeIngredient: 1/2 cup finely chopped green or red pepper

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Roll out crescent roll dough on a flat cookie sheet.
Bake until golden brown.
Mix cream cheese with ranch dressing.
Spread the cream cheese mixture onto the cooled crust.
Top with chopped vegetables.
Keep refrigerated before serving.
Cut with pizza cutter or knife.

_similar.keywords: veggie pizza, crescent roll crust, cream cheese, ranch dressing

_similar.name: Stuffing and Chicken
_similar.description: A comforting chicken breast casserole with Stove Top stuffing, Swiss cheese, and cream of chicken soup.
recipeIngredient: 4 boned and skinned chicken breast halves

recipeInstructions.text: Place chicken breasts in a sprayed 8×8 inch casserole dish.
Put a slice of Swiss cheese on top of each breast.
Spread 1⅓ cups of dry Stove Top stuffing over the cheese.
Spread the cream of chicken soup over the stuffing layer.
Bake at 350 °F for 1 hour.

_similar.keywords: chicken casserole, stuffing, Swiss cheese, comfort food

_similar.name: Parmesan Chicken
_similar.description: A crispy Parmesan-crusted chicken dish baked with spaghetti sauce and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix Parmesan cheese with bread crumbs and set aside.
Mix eggs, salt, and pepper.
Dip boneless chicken breasts in egg mixture, then coat with bread crumb mixture.
Arrange coated chicken breasts in a baking dish.
Cover with tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.
Pour spaghetti sauce over the chicken and continue baking.
Before serving, sprinkle grated mozzarella cheese on top and bake for an additional 10 minutes until browned.

_similar.keywords: Parmesan chicken, breaded chicken, Italian-American cuisine
